title: Crescenta
description: A Geopol / Roleplay server built by the players, for the players.
body:
Crescenta is a Worldbuilding Minecraft server where the world grows with the players, whether by the founding of grand civilizations, the formation of grand histories, or the exploration into grand new frontiers. We have it all!

We just created a new world, **Helios**, and we intend to keep it running for a *very* long time, so join in now to make your mark!

Here are some of Crescenta's features:
- A custom-coded ancestry system, complete with surnames, adoption, marriage, and so much more!
(we're still working on a feature list; please be patient)

It's An Entire World, All For You.
Write Your Story, and Make It Yours.
